name: NeverDrafts
author: NeverDrafts

sections.description:
NeverDrafts is a powerful WordPress plugin that automatically syncs blog posts from your NeverDrafts.com account directly to your WordPress site. With NeverDrafts, you can streamline your content publishing workflow and maintain consistency across your digital presence.

Key Features:

  • Seamless Integration: Connect your WordPress site to NeverDrafts.com with a simple connection key
  • Automatic Syncing: Posts are automatically synced from NeverDrafts to your WordPress site
  • Flexible Publishing Options: Choose to publish immediately, save as drafts, or keep posts private
  • Image Management: Automatically download and import images from synced posts to your media library
  • Category Assignment: Set default categories for synced posts
  • Author Management: Assign a default author for all synced content
  • Sync Logging: Track all sync activities with detailed logs and status reports
  • Connection Status: Real-time connection status monitoring
  • Test Connection: Built-in connection testing functionality

How It Works:

  1. Install and activate the NeverDrafts plugin
  2. Copy your unique Connection Key from the plugin settings
  3. Go to your NeverDrafts dashboard → Integrations
  4. Add a new WordPress integration using your Connection Key
  5. Your posts will automatically sync to WordPress!

Perfect For:

  • Content creators who want to automate their publishing workflow
  • Businesses managing multiple content channels
  • Bloggers who want to streamline their content distribution
  • Anyone looking to maintain consistent publishing across platforms

Technical Details

Requirements:
* WordPress 5.0 or higher
* PHP 7.4 or higher
* Active internet connection for syncing

API Endpoints:
The plugin creates the following REST API endpoints (namespace neverdrafts/v1):
* /wp-json/neverdrafts/v1/sync – Handles post syncing
* /wp-json/neverdrafts/v1/test – Connection testing
* /wp-json/neverdrafts/v1/connect – Connection establishment
* /wp-json/neverdrafts/v1/status – Plugin status information

Security:
* All API endpoints require authentication via Connection Key
* Input sanitization and validation
* SQL injection protection
* XSS prevention
* WordPress nonce verification for admin actions

Database:
Creates one custom table: wp_neverdrafts_sync_logs for tracking sync activities.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please contact us through NeverDrafts.com.

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to NeverDrafts.com to sync content. Please review the NeverDrafts privacy policy at https://neverdrafts.com/privacy for information about data handling.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/neverdrafts directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to NeverDrafts in your WordPress admin menu to configure the plugin.
  4. Copy your Connection Key and add it to your NeverDrafts.com account.
  5. Configure your sync settings (publishing status, default category, author, etc.).
  6. Test your connection and start syncing!
sections.faq:
How do I get a NeverDrafts account?

Visit NeverDrafts.com to sign up for an account and start creating automated blog content.

Can I customize how posts are published?

Yes! You can choose to publish posts immediately, save them as drafts, or keep them private. You can also set default categories and authors for all synced posts.

What happens to images in my posts?

The plugin can automatically download and import images from your synced posts into your WordPress media library, ensuring all images are hosted locally on your site.

Can I sync posts to multiple WordPress sites?

Yes! Each WordPress site gets its own unique Connection Key, so you can connect multiple sites to your NeverDrafts account.

Is there a limit to how many posts I can sync?

There are no limits imposed by the plugin itself. Any limits would be based on your NeverDrafts.com account plan.

What if I deactivate the plugin?

All synced posts remain on your WordPress site. The plugin only handles the syncing process – your content is safe.

Can I edit synced posts in WordPress?

Absolutely! Once posts are synced to WordPress, they become regular WordPress posts that you can edit, update, or manage as needed.
